verdicts.reason: Both break the yellow ribbon: its folded tails sit beside 'During' while the 'a Workout?' bar floats about 90px lower, and the headline sits on the busy finger and handlebar area, so the type is small and hard to read on a square canvas. B is worse because its top dashed rule is stretched across most of the width and cuts through the hand. A's rule is shorter but still clips the fingertip.
